High-point scoring

Series scored high point rather than RRS Appendix A's low point: a boat scores for the boats she beats, a race she misses scores 0, and the highest total wins. Boats beaten scores n + 1 − place (plus 1 for coming to the start, HalSail's HP scoring); CHIPS3 is ISORA's formula. n is the boats in the fleet's race whose result counts toward the fleet size. Each example checks numbers Bray Sailing Club or ISORA published.

Examples

#Scenario
1 Boats beaten with a point for coming to the start — Bray SC Sunday Dinghy Series 2025, race 4
2 Boats beaten — a tie for 4th, Bray SC Sunday Dinghy Series 2025, race 44
3 Boats beaten — an OCS counts in the fleet size, Bray SC Winter Series 2025/26, race 15
4 Boats beaten without the start point, DNS fixed at 1 — Bray SC Winter Series 2023/24, race 1
5 Boats beaten, a whole season — Bray SC Winter Series 2025/26, 19 races, one discard
6 CHIPS3 with declared boats in the fleet size — ISORA 2026, race 01CW1
7 CHIPS3 with a DNS left out of the fleet size — ISORA 2024, race 04CW2
8 CHIPS3 with a tie on corrected time — ISORA 2024, race 03CI2
9 CHIPS3 — a race nobody finished still counts, ISORA 2026, race 09O4
10 CHIPS3, a whole season — ISORA 2026, IRC Class 1, 18 races, best 5 count
11 CHIPS3 with weighted and unweighted races — ISORA 2025, Royal Dee Offshore Championship
12 Boats beaten — a lone boat scores 1, or 2 with the point for coming to the start
13 CHIPS3 — a lone boat scores 86.1, never 100
14 CHIPS3 in a two-handed division boats join race by race — ISORA 2026, Two-Handed, 18 races, best 5 count
15 Penalties under boats beaten — the mirror of low point
16 Penalties under CHIPS3 — a 20-boat race at ISORA's 1.1 weight
